plan.vision: A strict Spec Roadmap for a local, lightweight, and efficient chat application powered by a local LLM, designed to run on consumer hardware. The application will provide a command-line interface (CLI) for users to interact with the LLM, focusing on efficiency and minimal resource usage. Atomic milestones include: 1) Setting up the project structure, 2) Implementing the core LLM interaction, 3) Building the CLI, 4) Writing unit tests, and 5) Documenting the architecture. Testing Strategy: Unit tests will cover all core functionalities, including LLM interaction, CLI commands, and input/output handling.
plan.lessons_learned: To avoid past mistakes, this project will use memory-mapped files for efficient data handling, prioritize algorithmic efficiency over OOP overhead, and ensure that all dependencies are pinned in a virtual environment. The repository will be kept lightweight by excluding heavy directories with .gitignore, and clear setup scripts will be provided for reproducibility.
plan.commit_message: Implemented a local, lightweight, and efficient chat application powered by a local LLM with a CLI interface.

files_to_generate.instructions: Explain the project's purpose, architecture, and how to set it up and run it. Include a Mermaid diagram for clarity.

Implement the core logic for initializing the LLM and generating responses. Use a lightweight LLM model and ensure efficient memory usage. Functions to implement: `initialize_llm` and `generate_response`.
Implement the command-line interface for the chat application. Handle user input, call the LLM, and display responses. Functions to implement: `main` and `handle_input`.

Write unit tests for the core functionalities of the chat application. Test the LLM initialization, response generation, and CLI input handling. Import and use the actual generated modules without creating mock or stub classes.
Include entries to ignore venv, __pycache__, .env, and other heavy directories to keep the repository lightweight.
